name: Sightura AI SEO Scanner
author: sightura

sections.description:
The Sightura AI SEO Scanner helps you analyze your website’s visibility for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). As search evolves, ensuring that AI engines (such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude) can crawl and understand your site’s structure is important for technical SEO.

This lightweight, local tool audits your WordPress site to verify that AI crawlers can access your content.

What This Plugin Does:

  1. AI Crawler Permission Audit: Checks your robots.txt file to see if you are blocking bots like GPTBot, ClaudeBot, or PerplexityBot.
  2. Semantic Hierarchy Check: Verifies that your HTML structure (H1, H2, H3) is properly nested so Large Language Models (LLMs) can parse your content efficiently.
  3. Entity Schema Detection: Scans for JSON-LD Organization and Product schema markup to help AI engines understand your business entity.

How It Works

The plugin generates a live “AI Visibility Readiness Score” directly in your WordPress dashboard, highlighting specific technical areas where your site’s setup can be optimized for AI crawlers.

Sightura Pro (Optional Upgrade)

For advanced functionality, users can connect to Sightura’s Premium API to unlock:
* Live Multi-LLM Prompt Tracking.
* Automated Schema Generation.
* Direct GitHub Fix Deployments.
* White-Label PDF Reports for SEO Agencies.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Click the new “Sightura AI SEO” menu item in your sidebar to run your technical scan.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. The scanner runs locally in your WordPress admin dashboard and does not impact frontend page speed.

Why is my AI Readiness Score low?

If your theme is missing JSON-LD schema or your settings are accidentally blocking GPTBot, your score will reflect that these elements need to be updated for better AI crawler access.
